In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="DateManuf">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''. As [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] states that the Regginis Mol interceptor [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] had been discontinued twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] ago, they must have been discontinued in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the '''Reginnis Mol interceptor missile''' was discontinued.<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Minor]]'s [[Capperling's Cantina]], the leader of a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]], [[Ranquiv]], asked [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] if they could calibrate [[Caldorf VII interceptor missile|Caldorf VII]] and Regginis Mol interceptor [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] while offering them a job to calibrate them. Organa then confirmed that they could calibrate the former and wished luck to Ranquiv, as [[Gender/Legends|she]] believed it would be unlikely that he could find anyone who could calibrate the latter, remarking that they had been discontinued. The Chosen&mdash;who Solo suspected has asked if they could calibrate Regginis Mol missiles to test the pair's [[Programmer/Legends|programming]] knowledge&mdash;then gave the pair the job.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Regginis Mol interceptor missile was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
